Author: Macki
Name: Glance
Description: Public beta. Camera-facing gaze, configurable close-up framing, themed personality moods and a searchable catalog of unlocked in-game emotes. Customize facial expressions or opt into body animations. Configure with /glance. Timing and camera compatibility are experimental. Icon created with AI assistance.
Punchline: A little eye contact. A little personality.
Changelog: Smooth close-up transitions: zoom delta blends across a 0.75-yalm band instead of switching suddenly; camera angle eases in and out with configurable transition time (default 0.35 seconds). Original angle is restored after the exit blend.
